info.title: Wolffie Energy Management API
info.description:
Wolffie is a self-hosted home energy management system that orchestrates solar + battery installations.

Authentication flow:
1. Call POST /auth/login with your credentials
2. Copy the returned token
3. Click Authorize and paste the token
